interaction_revision: Revision 10: Revision 9 plus a Lineage panel comparing sixteen published architectures against the 2017 paper. Explore by default; optional one-minute story opens with both models side by side and keeps that layout throughout. Continuous camera paths move between 17 short, source-grounded beats without cuts or static holds; chapter navigation glides to its destination.

lineage.rule: Primary sources only: the model paper, its official config.json, or its vendor model card. Figures no primary source states are null and render as an em dash; nothing is taken from secondary reporting.
lineage.scope: Published architecture shape only. Not a benchmark, not a cost model, and not geometry: only the 2017 base model and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash exist as 3D scenes.

motion: Concurrent grouped activation pathways, schematic attention and expert routing, not inference timing. DSpark illustrates an accepted prefix of three of five candidates.

story.layout: Both models stay side by side at every viewport width
story.camera: Shape-preserving cubic paths with continuous position and velocity; 3–5 second beats
story.captions: Per-cue component names and factual comparisons of architecture, counts and operations.

validation.scope: Architecture invariants, story playback/camera continuity, and lineage sourcing against the frozen official configurations. Illustrative motion, not neural inference or benchmarking.
